source:
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel
g6 = run(6)
ch6 = resolve_channels(g6.meta)
I6 = g6.col(current_channel(ch6).col) / current_channel(ch6).gain
v6 = next(c for c in ch6 if c.cid == 'sr1')
R6 = (g6.col(v6.col) / v6.gain) / I6
B6 = g6.col('magnet_field')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 6), sharex=True)
ax[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=.8); ax[0].set_ylabel('raw Rxx (ohm)')
ax[1].plot(B6, I6*1e9, lw=.8); ax[1].set(ylabel='drain I (nA)', xlabel='B (T)')
fig.suptitle('data/6: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2, D=0; raw')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(summarize_run(g6))
print(f'Rxx {R6.min():.1f}..{R6.max():.1f} ohm; drain I {I6.min()*1e9:.2f}..{I6.max()*1e9:.2f} nA; T {g6.col("T_sample").min():.3f}..{g6.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K')

from scipy.signal import find_peaks
f6, sp6 = sdh_fft(R6[:, None], B6, b_range=(1.5, 10), bg_degree=5, log=False)
p6, _ = find_peaks(sp6[0], prominence=.1*sp6[0].max())
p6 = sorted(p6, key=lambda i: sp6[0,i], reverse=True)[:6]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.5))
ax.plot(f6, sp6[0]); ax.axvline(float(luttinger_frequency(3.2e16)), color='r', ls='--', label='full-density F=33.1 T')
ax.set(xlim=(0, 50), xlabel='SdH frequency (T)', ylabel='FFT magnitude', title='data/6: 1.5–10 T, polynomial background removed')
ax.legend(); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print('FFT peaks (T, relative amplitude):', [(round(float(f6[i]), 2), round(float(sp6[0,i]/sp6[0].max()), 2)) for i in p6])

Run 6 take: The electron trace has clear oscillations above about 2 T and no clipping (529.6 ohm maximum against roughly 5 kohm full scale). FFT peaks at 3.52, 7.05, 14.09, 22.9, and 29.94 T over 1.5–10 T; the 7/14/22/30 T spacing admits harmonics and the full-density estimate is 33.1 T using the run-5 geometry-anchored capacitance. This single trace cannot count pockets or separate the two series CNP regions. Drain current stayed 9.84–9.94 nA and sample-mount T 1.165–1.292 K (data/6). The fan will test branch slopes versus density before a stacking assignment.

## HERA — Step 4: electron Landau fan at calibrated D = 0 (`landau-fan`)

> **05:24** · landau-fan: D=0 electron n +0.8..+3.2e12 (49), B 0..10 T (71 rows), TG/BG co-swept, Si 0, sr1 100 uV, 2.4 s/point · **ETA ~09:39** (≈4h15m)

Plan step 4. Run 6 (data/6, n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻²) has SdH contrast from ~2 T upward, with 7.05, 14.09, 22.9 and 29.94 T exploratory FFT peaks; harmonics and the second series CNP region (run 5: offset −0.43×10¹² cm⁻²) prevent a pocket count from one cut. This fan varies density at each B to track branches, filling slopes and zero-mode behavior. Run 7 gives a hole-side preview but has less high-density reach. The measured run-5 CNP slope sets c_bg/c_tg = 0.773; absolute density still uses the 9.5 nm TG geometry prior, so slopes will also check that scale.

Sweep the calibrated D = 0 line on the electron side, n = +0.8…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² in 0.05×10¹² steps (49 points): (V_tg,V_bg) ≈ (+0.296,+0.276)…(+0.984,+1.166) V, inside the committed validators. B is the slow axis, 0→4 T in 0.1 T steps and 4.2→10 T in 0.2 T steps (71 rows), starting from the handoff's measured ~0 T and ending at 10 T; the fixed 0.137 T/min magnet slew costs at least 73 min. Each gate point dwells 2.4 s = 8τ at the verified 0.3 s / 24 dB lock-in setting; `sr1` is fixed at 100 µV (≈10 kΩ full scale at 10 nA), with a rail guard and 1 nA gate-current trip. Run 5 (1 s dwell) gives ~0.17 s read overhead/point; run 6's 10 T traverse took 2 h including 921 3 s magnet settles. Those calibrate ~3 h 48 min before margin, priced at **4 h 15 min**.

Coverage trade: this first fan excludes the CNP and hole side, where the two series regions overlap and a 10 kΩ range may rail; full D = 0 coverage would add about 40 gate points per B row (~2 h) plus possible re-range. We will decide on a focused complementary slice after this fan's branch read. **Checkpoints:** first two complete B rows (~5 min) for live T, drain current, gate leakage, sensitivity rail and nonflat Rxx; then around 3, 6 and 8 T inspect landed-row digests and interim maps, continuing only if the branches remain interpretable. If interrupted, read actual field and gate readbacks before any next move; the magnet may keep ramping after a kernel interrupt.

# === calibrated D=0 electron Landau fan; plan step 4 ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Preconditions assumed, not set by this cell: live base thermometry, zero field,
# zero Si, magnet output/switch state, lock-in drive and filtering, committed fences.
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live("T_vaporizer", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_vaporizer"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B, _Vsi = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_amp, _freq, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"precondition T_sample={_Ts:.3f} K (1.0–1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K (<1.6), "
      f"B={_B:+.4f} T (|B|<0.02), Si={_Vsi:+.4f} V (0), "
      f"PS={magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output={magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"drive={_amp:.3f} V at {_freq:.3f} Hz (~{_amp/100e6*1e9:.2f} nA), "
      f"tau={_tau:.3f} s, slope={_slope} dB/oct; heaters={heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()}, "
      f"DC205 range/output={dc205.voltage_range()}/{dc205.output()}")
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_B) < 0.02 and abs(_Vsi) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert abs(_amp-1.0) < 0.01 and abs(_freq-13.777) < 0.01 and _tau <= 0.3 and _slope == 24
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert dc205.voltage_range() == 2 and dc205.output() == 1
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert [_vr(p.vals) for p in (k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt, dc205.smart_voltage, magnet.field)] == [(-0.3,1.0),(-1.3,2.0),(-25.0,25.0),(-10.0,10.0)]

# Run-5 CNP-line calibration. c_tg is geometry anchored; c_bg/c_tg and offsets are session-measured.
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.7960593093052633e-3, c_bg=2.160696465377614e-3,
           n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.linspace(0.8, 3.2, 49), 4)  # 1e12 cm^-2; 0.05e12 spacing
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), **CAL)
B_vec = np.round(np.r_[np.linspace(0, 4, 41), np.linspace(4.2, 10, 30)], 4)
assert len(B_vec) == 71 and len(Vtg_vec) == len(Vbg_vec) == 49
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX
assert np.max(np.abs(B_vec)) <= B_SESSION_CAP
_nr, _Dr = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, **CAL)
assert np.max(np.abs(_nr-n_vec)) < 1e-9 and np.max(np.abs(_Dr)) < 1e-9
print(f"fan: B {B_vec[0]:.1f}→{B_vec[-1]:.1f} T ({len(B_vec)} rows); "
      f"n {n_vec[0]:.2f}→{n_vec[-1]:.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts); "
      f"TG {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}→{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V, BG {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}→{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V")

FAST_DELAY, I_TRIP = 2.4, 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)  # ~10 kohm full scale at 10 nA
_sens = sr1.sensitivity()
print(f"sr1 sensitivity {_sens*1e6:.0f} uV, estimated R full scale {_sens/(_amp/100e6):.0f} ohm; fast dwell {FAST_DELAY:.1f} s = {FAST_DELAY/_tau:.1f} tau")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = _Vsi; mc["sample_temperature:"] = _Ts
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan electron D=0, run-5 cal; n +0.8..+3.2e12/0.05e12, "
                  "B 0..4/0.1 then 4.2..10/0.2 T, sr1 100uV, fast_delay 2.4s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('electron D=0; run-5 cal ratio 0.772765, n_offset -0.08938e12, D_offset -0.013 V/nm; '
              'n +0.8..+3.2e12 cm^-2 (49 x 0.05e12), B 0..10 T (71 rows: 0.1 T to 4, 0.2 T above); '
              'TG +0.296..+0.984 V, BG +0.276..+1.166 V; Si 0 V, base T; sr1 sens 100uV, delay 2.4s')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbg_vec[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtg_vec[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# multimegasweep row: time, B, TG, BG, T, I_tg, I_bg, sr0.X/P, sr1.X/P
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    _bt, _it, _ib, _v = map(float, (data[1], data[5], data[6], data[9]))
    if abs(_it) > I_TRIP or abs(_ib) > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP B={_bt:.3f} T, |I_tg|={abs(_it):.3e}, |I_bg|={abs(_ib):.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if abs(_v) > 0.90*_sens:
        print(f"RAIL TRIP B={_bt:.3f} T, |sr1.X|={abs(_v):.3e} V vs sens={_sens:.3e} V")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

try:
    _fan_result = s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt],
                                   [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec], slow_delay=0, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # The run ends at its actual B; gate sources return to the committed 0 V park.
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
print(f"done: interrupted={_fan_result.metadata.get('interrupted')}, B readback={magnet.field():+.4f} T, "
      f"TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V")
